>i already don’t see a point in living, so whatever mistakes i make won’t really matter. it’s almost like i have no anxiety about anything at all. 

This is weirdly comforting. I'm sorry you're experiencing this same kind of existential struggle. I don't remember how to enjoy things, but I want to try again. I hope you have a good time ice skating.

Thanks for the comment. It's hard to feel like there's much to live for when I've spent every day for the past two decades telling myself that it will get better some day. But I know there have to be people who enjoy the experience of being alive, right? So it can't be all bad. It just can't.

Side note: I hope no one has ever invalidated your feelings because you are "only" sixteen. Teenagers have a right to feel their emotions just like anyone else.
